titleEnglish: The Night Journey and Ascension (Isra and Mi'raj)

verses.ar: ثُمَّ أُسْرِيَ بِرُوحِهِ وَجَسَدِهِ يَقَظَةً مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ الْأَقْصَى وَرِحَابِهِ الْقُدْسِيَّةْ ۞ وَعُرِجَ بِهِ إِلَى السَّمَاوَاتِ فَرَأَى آدَمَ فِي الْأُولَى وَقَدْ جَلَّلَهُ الْوَقَارُ وَعَلَاهْ ۞ وَرَأَى فِي الثَّانِيَةِ عِيسَى ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ الْبَتُولِ الْبَرَّةِ التَّقِيَّةْ
verses.tr: Thumma usriya bi-rūḥihi wa-jasadihi yaqaẓatan mina l-Masjidi l-Ḥarāmi ilā l-Masjidi l-Aqṣā wa-riḥābihi l-qudsiyyah, wa-ʿurija bihi ilā s-samāwāti fa-ra'ā Ādama fī l-ūlā wa-qad jallalahu l-waqāru wa-ʿalāh, wa-ra'ā fī th-thāniyati ʿĪsa-bna Maryama l-batūli l-barrati t-taqiyyah.
verses.en: Then he was taken by night, in body and spirit while awake, from al-Masjid al-Haram to al-Masjid al-Aqsa and its sacred precincts. He was then raised through the heavens, where in the first heaven he saw Adam, clothed and encompassed in dignity. And in the second heaven he saw Isa, son of Maryam, the chaste, righteous, and God-fearing woman.

verses.ar: وَابْنَ خَالَتِهِ يَحْيَى الَّذِي أُوتِيَ الْحُكْمَ فِي حَالِ صِبَاهْ ۞ وَرَأَى فِي الثَّالِثَةِ يُوسُفَ الصِّدِّيقَ بِصُورَتِهِ الْجَمَالِيَّةْ ۞ وَفِي الرَّابِعَةِ إِدْرِيسَ الَّذِي رَفَعَ اللّٰهُ مَكَانَهُ وَأَعْلَاهْ ۞ وَفِي الْخَامِسَةِ هَارُونَ الْمُحَبَّبَ فِي الْأُمَّةِ الْإِسْرَائِيلِيَّةْ ۞ وَفِي السَّادِسَةِ مُوسَى الَّذِي كَلَّمَهُ اللّٰهُ وَنَاجَاهْ
verses.tr: Wa-bna khālatihi Yaḥya lladhī ūtiya l-ḥukma fī ḥāli ṣibāh, wa-ra’ā fī th-thālithati Yūsufa ṣ-Ṣiddīqa bi-ṣūratihi l-jamāliyyah, wa-fī r-rābiʿati Idrīsa lladhī rafaʿa Llāhu makānahu wa-aʿlāh, wa-fī l-khāmisati Hārūna l-muḥabbaba fī l-ummati l-Isrā'īliyyah, wa-fī s-sādisati Mūsa lladhī kallamahu Llāhu wa-nājāh.
verses.en: And with him was his maternal cousin Yahya, who was granted wisdom while still a child. In the third heaven, he saw Yusuf al-Siddiq in his beautiful form, and in the fourth, Idris, whose station Allah raised and exalted. In the fifth, he saw Harun, beloved among the Children of Israel, and in the sixth, Musa, whom Allah spoke to and communed with privately.

verses.ar: وَفِي السَّابِعَةِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الَّذِي جَاءَ رَبَّهُ بِسَلَامَةِ الْقَلْبِ وَالطَّوِيَّةْ ۞ وَحَفِظَهُ مِنْ نَارِ نَمْرُودَ وَعَافَاهْ ۞ ثُمَّ رُفِعَ إِلَى سِدْرَةِ الْمُنْتَهَى إِلَى أَنْ سَمِعَ صَرِيفَ الْأَقْلَامِ بِالْأُمُورِ الْمَقْضِيَّةْ ۞ إِلَى مَقَامِ الْمُكَافَحَةِ الَّذِي قَرَّبَهُ اللّٰهُ فِيهِ وَأَدْنَاهْ ۞ وَأَمَاطَ لَهُ حُجُبَ الْأَنْوَارِ الْجَلَالِيَّةْ
verses.tr: Wa-fī s-sābiʿati Ibrāhīma lladhī jā'a Rabbahu bi-salāmati l-qalbi wa ṭ-ṭawiyyah, wa-ḥafiẓahu min nāri Namrūda wa-ʿāfāh, thumma rufiʿa ilā Sidrati l-Muntahā ilā an samiʿa ṣarīfa l-aqlāmi bi-l-umūri l-maqḍiyyah, ilā maqāmi l-mukāfaḥati lladhī qarrabahu Llāhu fīhi wa-adnāh, wa-amāṭa lahu ḥujuba l-anwāri l-jalāliyyah.
verses.en: And in the seventh heaven, he saw Ibrahim, who came to his Lord with a sound heart and pure inner disposition, and whom Allah preserved from the fire of Namrud and kept safe. Then he was raised to Sidrat al-Muntaha, until he heard the scratching of the pens recording the matters already decreed. He was then raised to the station of direct encounter, where Allah brought him near and drew him close, and removed for him the veils of majestic lights.

verses.ar: وَأَرَاهُ بِعَيْنَيْ رَأْسِهِ مِنْ حَضْرَةِ الرُّبُوبِيَّةِ مَا أَرَاهْ ۞ وَبَسَطَ لَهُ بُسُطَ الْإِدْلَالِ فِي الْمَجَالِي الذَّاتِيَّةْ ۞ وَفَرَضَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى أُمَّتِهِ خَمْسِينَ صَلَاةً ۞ ثُمَّ انْهَلَّ سَحَابُ الْفَضْلِ فَرُدَّتْ إِلَى خَمْسٍ عَمَلِيَّةْ ۞ وَلَهَا أَجْرُ الْخَمْسِينَ كَمَا شَاءَهُ فِي الْأَزَلِ وَقَضَاهْ
verses.tr: Wa-arāhu bi-ʿaynay ra'sihi min ḥaḍrati r-rubūbiyyati mā arāh, wa-basaṭa lahu busuṭa l-idlāli fī l-majālī dh-dhātiyyah, wa-faraḍa ʿalayhi wa-ʿalā ummatihi khamsīna ṣalātan, thumma nhalla saḥābu l-faḍli fa-ruddat ilā khamsin ʿamaliyyah, wa-lahā ajru l-khamsīna kamā shā'ahu fī l-azali wa-qaḍāh.
verses.en: And with his own eyes, he was shown from the Presence of Lordship what he was shown. The carpets of intimate favour were spread out for him amid the manifestations of the Divine Essence. And fifty prayers were made obligatory upon him and his community. Then the cloud of Divine Grace poured forth, and they were reduced to five in practice, while retaining the reward of fifty, just as He had willed and decreed in eternity.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ عَادَ فِي لَيْلَتِهِ بِالْمَوَاهِبِ اللَّدُنِّيَّةْ ۞ فَصَدَّقَهُ الصِّدِّيقُ بِمَسْرَاهْ ۞ وَكُلُّ ذِي عَقْلٍ وَرَوِيَّةْ ۞ وَكَذَّبَتْهُ قُرَيْشٌ وَارْتَدَّ مَنْ أَضَلَّهُ الشَّيْطَانُ وَأَغْوَاهْ
verses.tr: Thumma ʿāda fī laylatihi bi-l-mawāhibi l-ladunniyyah fa-ṣaddaqahu ṣ-Ṣiddīqu bi-masrāh, wa-kullu dhī ʿaqlin wa-rawiyyah, wa-ka-dhdhabathu Qurayshun wa-rtadda man aḍallahu sh-shayṭānu wa-aghwāh.
verses.en: Then he returned that same night bearing divinely bestowed gifts. Al-Siddiq believed him concerning his Night Journey, as did every person of intellect and sound judgement. Quraysh denied him, while those whom Satan had led astray and beguiled apostatised.

verses.ar:
عَطِّرِ اللّٰهُمَّ قَبْرَهُ الْكَرِيمَ بِعَرْفٍ شَذِيٍّ مِنْ صَلَاةٍ وَتَسْلِيمٍ
اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ
verses.tr:
ʿAṭṭiri Llāhumma qabrahu l-karīma bi-ʿarfin shadhiyyin min ṣalātin wa-taslīmin.
Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim wa-bārik ʿalayhi.
verses.en:
O Allah, perfume his noble grave with a fragrant scent of prayers and peace.
O Allah, send prayers, peace, and blessings upon him.
